name: photowall
description: Photo Wall v2 — parede de fotos em tempo real para eventos

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/wall && npm run build -w apps/admin
scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -n server,wall,admin -c blue,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/wall" "npm run dev -w apps/admin"
